About this item

  • LUXURY GLASS CANDLE - Designed to burn cleanly and infuse your home with exceptional scent, this candle elevates everyday living and entertaining. It is housed in a glass vessel etched with elegant, frosted stripes that complement any decor.
  • FRESH FLORALS - Flowering bamboo combines with white florals, an abundance of lush green notes, and hints of sparkling citrus in this sophisticated fragrance, which creates an enchanting mood in your home.
  • CLEAN BURN - This exquisitely fragranced candle is crafted with a proprietary premium wax, so the candle burns cleanly and evenly for 75-100 hours.
  • CRUELTY FREE - This decorative scented candle is vegan and made in the USA without animal testing.
  • SCENT YOUR WORLD - NEST New York’s fragranced home, perfume, and body care collections transform the everyday by artfully blending notes of the familiar, the exotic, and the unexpected for a fragrance experience like no other.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Gift someone a “signature candle scent?” Yes!
    Reviewed in the United States on April 22, 2024
    Scent: Bamboo
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    It was a gift. Never expected it to become part of my life, but Nest candles are easy to love. They make impressive gifts, a little pricey, but man, are they worth it! The bamboo scent is kind of perfect for anyone, especially couples. Not flowery, powdery, or musky, the Bamboo scent is fresh and lush without being heavy. After years with my three wicks, I bought the NEST lid—cool and silvery—to keep it free from dust. I also tried NEST candles in different sizes for different places, and I’ve come to appreciate every NEST chic etched glass surround. Long after the candle is gone, the empty three-wick becomes a vase for spring flowers, shiny Christmas ornaments, or berries at brunch. Smaller candle jars hold candies, stamps,

    Q-Tips, and lip glosses. Brace yourself—you’ll be hooked!

    I love that these candles do no smoke, smell wonderful, have great "throw" (they fill up my entire open concept kitchen and living room with 20 ft. ceilings very quickly) and the scent lingers for a couple of hours. They are expensive but I thought, why not :). The reason I generally do not burn candles is you can hardly smell them in our open rooms and the smoke and leave soot. So if you add up the cost for all the candles I have purchased that have been ineffective, I feel like these are sort of a bargain. That is what I told my husband and I am sure he agrees....

About this Item

  • LUXURY GLASS CANDLE - Designed to burn cleanly and infuse your home with exceptional scent, this candle elevates everyday living and entertaining. It is housed in a glass vessel etched with elegant, frosted stripes that complement any decor.
  • FRESH FLORALS - Flowering bamboo combines with white florals, an abundance of lush green notes, and hints of sparkling citrus in this sophisticated fragrance, which creates an enchanting mood in your home.
  • CLEAN BURN - This exquisitely fragranced candle is crafted with a proprietary premium wax, so the candle burns cleanly and evenly for 75-100 hours.
  • CRUELTY FREE - This decorative scented candle is vegan and made in the USA without animal testing.
  • SCENT YOUR WORLD - NEST New York’s fragranced home, perfume, and body care collections transform the everyday by artfully blending notes of the familiar, the exotic, and the unexpected for a fragrance experience like no other.
